bio: Here, charming old features are enhanced by an eye for designer details (contemporary art, open kitchen). Original, well-crafted cuisine (semi-cooked line-caught albacore tuna from the Basque country, cream of pumpkin soup with coconut milk; cod confit ravioli, broth with herbs and spices, trout roe and sweet spice tuile), accompanied by a fine wine list. A master class in tastefully mixing the traditional and modern, in the decor as well as in the food....
